reader_summary.headline: The seventh episode of Season One of Private Equity Deals released this morning.
reader_summary.overview: The seventh episode of Season One of Private Equity Deals released this morning. I'm joined by Tricia Glynn, Managing Director at Advent International. We discuss their purchase of Orveon, a carve out of Shiseido comprised of three beauty brands.

key_points.text: The transaction highlights the many moving parts of carveouts, a transaction Advent has completed 80 times over the years.
Tune in to Private Equity Deals to hear the story.
